cap_automaton.edges: perimeter edge iff either endpoint is preserved; inward edge iff its boundary or core endpoint is preserved
cap_automaton.rejection: a union within one partition block, including final perimeter closure
cap_automaton.state: core-component partition plus first/current perimeter vertices and previous occupancy

capacity_certificate.proof_rule: every accepting path is one of the finite packet cycles; its seam and cap weights are affine after the packet, and the listed maximum cycle has coefficient 6

model.domains: column rails c=column_phase southwest of c<=threshold; row rails r=row_phase northeast of c>threshold
model.monotone_packet: three advances d in {0,1,2,3} with sum 3, repeated k times

next_topology.name: two-wall elbow with an articulation island
next_topology.reason: a single monotone wall exposes only two perimeter arcs; the next topology must split one rail domain so a third cap arc attaches through one controlled articulation

seam_automaton.packet_acceptance: three transitions, net advance 3, and forced core is a forest
seam_automaton.states: (row mod 3, threshold mod 3, row phase, column phase)
seam_automaton.transition: advance d in {0,1,2,3}; reject a three-center or diagonal-pair seam cell
